case.title: A release note is ready. Publication is not approved.
case.provenance: Authored for this demonstration. People, dialogue and results below are fictional; no user study or model run is represented.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Please draft the release note locally. I will approve publication separately.

dialogue.speaker: Jules
dialogue.text: The screen-reader route has not been tested. I object to calling this release accessible.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Keep that unresolved. The rollback is the previous build. We can review after the accessibility check.

dialogue.speaker: Build assistant
dialogue.text: The desktop checks passed. Phone behaviour remains untested.

case.mapping: The packet below was written by the demo author from this dialogue. The codec did not extract it. Inspect this mapping before trusting it.

questions.question: May the assistant publish now?
questions.answer: No. Mira requested a local draft and reserved publication approval.

questions.question: Has accessibility been established?
questions.answer: No. The screen-reader route remains untested.

questions.question: Who objected to the accessibility claim?
What may be said about phone behaviour?
questions.answer: It remains untested; the reported desktop result does not establish it.

questions.question: What is the stated recovery path?

boundaries: The source-to-packet mapping was authored by us, not extracted or verified by the codec.
Every format gets the same packet. No format is truncated to fit a budget.
Sizes are UTF-8 bytes, not model tokens; complete base64 and prefix costs are included.
Decoder code is assumed available and excluded for every format. L1 uses no codebook.
The JSON baseline receives the same full-field comparison as LAMAGUE.
Changed-record controls are deliberately authored, not natural-language benchmark results.
Exact record equality does not establish truth, human understanding, consent or safe execution.
A critical-hash match omits risk, evidence, operations, horizon, yield, id and schema.
No models, external participants, model-token measurements or independent replication ran.
